short: Dokja sounds like the Korean word for reader.
note: Dokja and the Korean word for reader have the same sound. The author’s “dear reader” can also be heard as a polite address to Dokja.

short: A term for adolescent fantasies of exceptional powers or importance.
note: The Korean expression here means “second-year middle-school syndrome.” It refers to adolescent fantasies of hidden powers or exceptional importance. Chuunibyou is the spelling used for the attribute in the ORV wiki.
